runs.label: m10_compute_bench_20261105_v1
runs.what: standalone 1-row routed-expert compute microbenchmark on one M10 GM107 (src/bench_m10_expert_compute.cu): deployed dynamic_gate_layer/dynamic_down_layer vs hoisted / paired gate-up, 2-expert / transposed-layout / 4-thread-split down, at 10/20/40 blocks (128/64/32 register caps); synthetic 126 MB layer, 64 expert sets, 2000 iterations; bit-identity vs deployed
runs.pre_reg: deployed b10: gate/up 28-34 us (T275 33.8 incl. staging+barrier), down 18-22 us (T275 21.5); hoist or pair gate/up 20-35 % faster at b10; transposed down 20-40 % faster; b20 faster than b10 for gate/up; b40 (32 regs) spills, likely no better; all variants bit-identical
runs.result: device 0000:05:00.0 (mem 2600 MHz x 128 bit = 83.2 GB/s peak). b10 (us, median): deployed gate/up 32.77 (51 GB/s), down 23.55 all blocks / 19.46 block 0 (40 GB/s) = production T275 33.8/21.5; grid barrier ~2.0 us (no-down variant). hoist+k2: 31.74 / 21.50 (bit-identical). pair gate/up + transposed down: 30.72 / 19.46 all, 16.38 block 0 (55 / 46 GB/s, bit-identical). All 20/40-block variants SKIPPED: max 3 blocks/SM (shared memory: q38_routed_xbuf 2*H floats ~ 21-24 KB per block), not registers. Result: -2 us gate/up, -4 us down at the deployed 10-block config.

runs.label: m10_compute_bench_20261105_v2
runs.what: compute microbenchmark extended: 1-row x buffer (10 KB, if constexpr so variants only allocate what they use) -> up to 5 blocks/SM; deployed gate/up math and pair gate/up at 10/15/20/25 blocks; down: deployed, transposed, 2-threads-per-row split (bit-identical chain order)
runs.pre_reg: prodsmall b10 = deployed b10 (32.8 / 23.6 us); gate/up at b20 20-30 % faster than b10 (more warps hide latency), b25 no better (48-51 regs, spills for pair); split2 down at b20 25-40 % faster than deployed down; best combination gate/up + down <= 42 us vs 56.4 (deployed); all bit-identical
runs.result: means (us, gate/up + down incl. grid barriers): deployed b10 33.12+23.18=56.30; 1-row buffer b10 31.44+21.03=52.48, b15 51.75, b20 51.34, b25 51.59; pair+trans b10 50.50; split2 down b20 50.30; pair+trans b20 50.33. Occupancy (16->40 warps/SM) adds ~nothing beyond the ILP variants: gate/up floors at ~30 us (~56 GB/s, 67 % of 83.2 GB/s peak; ~60 GB/s without barrier+staging), down at ~20 us (~46 GB/s). Same gate/up code differs ~2 us with/without the following down (31.25 vs 33.12), so 1-2 us differences are at the noise level. All variants bit-identical. => the 1-row compute is near the M10's practical bandwidth; realistic gain ~6 us/layer.
